name: 14-brusselator-model-agnostic
title: Model-agnostic node reactor — Brusselator (proposed)
question: Is the SBML-at-nodes architecture model-agnostic — does swapping the Repressilator for a Brusselator reproduce reaction–diffusion patterning on the network with no code change?
hypothesis: Because NetworkSBMLReactors loads any SBML model and NetworkTransport diffuses any species, pointing them at a Brusselator yields Turing-like patterning / synchronisation on the network with the identical process code.
objective: Vendor a Brusselator SBML, point the reactors at it, and reproduce a Family-B/C study to demonstrate model-independence.
description:
Proposed follow-up seeded from study 11. Demonstrates the node model is a plug-in, not hardcoded.

(Baseline points at the composite this proposal would EXTEND; the new mechanism is not yet built.)

expected_behavior.name: model-swap-works
expected_behavior.condition: a different SBML model runs on the network with no process code change
expected_behavior.rationale: The reactor/transport processes read species generically from basico, so any SBML model should work.

report.verdict_detail: Proposed follow-up — not yet built or run. Seeded from 11-coevolving-growing-network (model-agnostic-brusselator).
